title: Oven Baked Jambalaya
description: A sixteen-serving batch of Creole classic! Chicken, ham, shrimp, and Andouille sausage are combined with onion celery, green pepper and garlic. Tomatoes, chicken stock and rice are stirred in, and the whole thing is baked in a large roasting pan.
ingredients: 3 tablespoons Creole seasoning blend (such as the one linked in the footnote)
3 cups cooked chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Melt butter in large stock pot. Saute onion, green pepper, celery and garlic until tender, being careful not to burn the garlic. Add tomato paste and cook to brown slightly, stirring constantly. Stir in bay leaves, Creole seasoning blend and Worcestershire sauce. Pour into a large roasting pan. Squeeze tomatoes to break up into pieces, and add to mixture in pan. Stir in juice from tomatoes, chicken stock, ham, sausage, chicken, shrimp and rice. Mix well. Cover tightly with aluminum foil.
Bake in preheated oven for 1 1/2 hours, stirring once halfway through baking time. Remove bay leaves before serving.

video.description: So you’ve always wanted to try your hand at the Creole classic but were intimidated by all the steps? This recipe simplifies the process while delivering all the bold flavors you love. Begin by simmering up a mirepoix, or trinity, of onion, green pepper and celery in butter along with some garlic. Add tomato paste, bay leaves, Creole seasoning and Worcestershire sauce. Pour into your extra-large roasting pan along with tomatoes, chicken stock, ham, sausage, chicken, shrimp and rice. Bake for an hour and a half and serve to a hungry crowd—the full flavor ensures that there won’t be any leftovers!
